info.headline: Lightning Amber Warning (Be Prepared)
info.description: Warning Description: Thundershowers accompanied by severe lightning are likely to occur after 1.00 p.m. today at several places in the mentioned areas.
info.instruction: Action Required: • Suspend or postpone outdoor sports, construction, agricultural and recreational activities when thunderstorms approach. • Move immediately into a substantial building or an enclosed hard-topped vehicle. • Avoid beaches, swimming areas, lakes, rivers and other water bodies. • Do not shelter under isolated trees, tents, open sheds or partially enclosed structures. • Stay away from electrical appliances, plumbing and wired electrical systems during thunderstorms. • Cancel or move outdoor events to safe indoor locations. • Keep children and vulnerable persons indoors. Damage Expected: • Increased probability of thunderstorms and lightning strikes. • Significant disruption to outdoor work, sports, agricultural activities and public • events. • Risk of serious injury or death to people exposed outdoors. • Damage to electrical and electronic equipment. • Possible disruption to electricity and communication services. • Potential for associated strong winds and heavy rainfall. • Localized infrastructure damage and transport disruption.
